snapshot.title: Award XP on free ops mission launch
snapshot.description: AppController defines XP_AWARD_LAUNCH = 5 but it is never called for post-tutorial (free ops) mission launches. Level Progression doc lists mission launches as an XP source. Currently players only earn XP from debrief, making free ops progression feel slower than tutorial.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Launching a mission in free ops mode awards XP_AWARD_LAUNCH XP
XP award fires at launch, not at debrief, so cancelled missions still reward exploration
Tutorial missions (M1-M4) are unaffected (already award XP correctly)
